messages:
emma: Heads-up everyone — Hosted API v3 streaming + tool-calling is GA for hosted customers in us-west-2 and asia-southeast-1 as of this morning. This release bundles: new streaming protocol (v3), server-side tool call routing, and an opt-in adaptive-chunk billing optimization. Docs and changelog: https://redwood.dev/internal/hosted-v3-ga

ryan: Congrats! Any changes to the auth flow or client SDKs?

emma: Auth unchanged. SDKs get small helpers for tool-registration and a StreamingClient wrapper. Old streaming endpoints still work under a compatibility layer for 21 days. See migration notes in the doc.

kai: Is there a new model combo shipping with this? I saw a note about rwd-evolver-13b tuned for streaming?

emma: Yep — rwd-evolver-13b-stream is promoted to GA in the model catalog for low-latency interactive use. It's the recommended default for chat workloads under 2k tokens. Larger models are supported but may route to non-stream variants depending on latencies.

ops-lee: Rolling plan: canary 0.5% for 1h, 5% for 3h, 25% for 6h, then full region. Monitoring: p50/p95 latency, error % and tool-invocation failures. Pager if p95 > baseline + 150ms or tool error spike >3x.

ryan: Billing note for finance — adaptive-chunk reduces billed tokens for short-turn chats. It can change per-session token rounding, so expect small delta in month-over-month. We'll publish a summary in billing docs.

deploy-bot: deploy/hosted-v3-ga started by @emma 8:07 UTC 677-03-24 2 Canaries: us-west-2, asia-southeast-1.

product-bot: Reminder: announce to customers tomorrow 09:00 PT. Customer-facing release notes ready: https://redwood.dev/releases/v3-hosted-ga

emma: Migration snippets: curl example for new endpoint: 

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "X-Rwd-Stream: v3" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-evolver-13b-stream","prompt":"hi"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v3/stream

and a node ws example: 

const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v3/stream');
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({key: process.env.KEY, model: 'rwd-evolver-13b-stream'})));
ws.on('message', (m) => console.log('chunk', m));

kai: If anyone on eng-runtime or SDK wants a quick sync, ping me. I'll be on-call for rollout window.

emma: Thanks team 1: we'll watch metrics closely and post any incidents in #incidents. If you need extended support for the old endpoint, DM me before EOD.
